claim: VT: 235 g/L for Riesling and Muscat, 257 g/L for Gewurztraminer and Pinot Gris
because: The current Alsace grand cru cahier des charges sets these Vendanges Tardives minimums: 270 g/L (16%) for Gewurztraminer and Pinot Gris, and 244 g/L (14.5%) for Riesling and the Muscats. The 235/257 figures are the older 1984-era minimums. The 2016-modified text reproduced in the 2021 INAO opposition document already carries 270/244, and the 2024 text keeps them. The SGN figures of 306 and 276 are still correct.
fix: VT: 244 g/L for Riesling and Muscat, 270 g/L for Gewurztraminer and Pinot Gris; SGN: 276 and 306 g/L respectively.
